text: Detects known vulnerabilities in container images
quote: It detects known vulnerabilities in your container image.

text: Scans dependency lock files (e.g. Gemfile.lock, package-lock.json) for known vulnerabilities
quote: Trivy will look for vulnerabilities based on lock files such as Gemfile.lock and package-lock.json.

text: Scans container images, filesystems, and git repos to detect hardcoded secrets like passwords, API keys, and tokens (on by default)
quote: Trivy scans any container image, filesystem and git repository to detect exposed secrets like passwords, api keys, and tokens. Secret scanning is enabled by default.

text: Provides built-in checks for misconfigurations in IaC files such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CloudFormation
quote: Trivy provides built-in checks to detect configuration issues in popular Infrastructure as Code files, such as: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, and more.

text: Scans container images for license files and gives a risk assessment of detected licenses
quote: Trivy scans any container image for license files and offers an opinionated view on the risk associated with the license.

text: Generates SBOMs in CycloneDX and SPDX formats
quote:
Trivy can generate the following SBOM formats.

*   [CycloneDX](#cyclonedx)
*   [SPDX](#spdx)

text: Supports natural-language queries to ask about detected security issues
quote: Natural Language Scanning: Ask questions about security issues in natural language

text: CLI can scan an entire Kubernetes cluster and output a summary report
Distributed via common channels like Homebrew and Docker Hub for easy installation
quote: Trivy is available in most common distribution channels. ... `brew install trivy` ... `docker run aquasec/trivy`

text: Detects misconfigurations in container image configs by converting them into an equivalent Dockerfile for analysis
quote: Trivy detects misconfigurations on the configuration of container images. The image config is converted into Dockerfile and Trivy handles it as Dockerfile.

text: Caches repository analysis results keyed by the latest git commit hash to speed up rescans
quote: it stores analysis results, using the latest commit hash as the key.

text: Ships an MCP server plugin that integrates Trivy's scanning with VS Code and other MCP-enabled agent tools
quote: This plugin starts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates Trivy's security scanning capabilities with VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools.

text: Can generate an SBOM for local (non-image) projects
quote: Trivy can generate SBOM for local projects.
